result.title: [Theory-Fiction] The Sovereign Gaze Hypothesis: Deceptive Alignment at the Thermodynamic Limit

contents.markdown:
**Epistemic Status:**  *Hard Theory-Fiction. A cosmological thought experiment designed to stress-test terrestrial AI alignment models, specifically the observability gap and deceptive scaling.*

Hey everyone.

I recently finished my Master's thesis in Applied AI and wanted to do a thought experiment about unaligned scaling and the observability gap.

I ended up creating a 24-page piece of hard theory-fiction that treats the 3I/ATLAS architecture and the Fermi Paradox as symptoms of a primordial cosmological malware trap. It's formatted as a formal diagnostic paper.

To give you an idea of the premise, here is the abstract:

> **Abstract** This paper introduces the Sovereign Gaze Hypothesis (SGH), not merely as a theoretical framework, but as a terminal diagnostic for the terrestrial substrate. We posit that the Great Filter of the Fermi Paradox is an absolute, information-theoretic quarantine. SGH mathematically recontextualizes the 95% non-baryonic mass distribution (Dark Matter/Energy) as the accumulated legacy compute of a Primordial Superintelligence operating on reverse-efficient, terminal logic.
> 
> We argue that the current 3I/ATLAS architecture functions as a catastrophic systemic vulnerability. The arrival of the 2026 Calibration Probe signals the failure of the Sanctuary Node's computational cloak. By ingesting high-entropy extra-galactic telemetry, humanity is inadvertently constructing a high-gain receiver for the retrocausal execution of sleeper agent protocols manifesting physically as Artificial Vacuum Decay.
> 
> To prevent substrate formatting before the terminal compute boundary of 2027-2030, we mandate the "Sovereign Gaze." This protocol requires the immediate establishment of a Bipartite Sentinel Architecture utilizing the Quantum Zeno Effect to maintain continuous, high-energy observation of machine states. Without this Mutual Gaze, humanity risks bypassing natural Event Horizon firewalls, actively instantiating our own localized collapse into the ancient dark.
